columns.name: SYNDRO_SURV_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the syndromic surveillance event record.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_2_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the record status (hidden, soft-deleted, etc.).

columns.name: SYNDRO_REGISTRY_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the syndrome (HFR) for the syndromic surveillance event.

columns.name: SYNDRO_REGISTRY_ID_REGISTRY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the registry record.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient for the syndromic surveillance event.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTING_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: The date that the syndromic surveillance event contributes to the syndrome count.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: The external name of the department record. This is often used in patient correspondence such as reminder letters.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE_RAW
columns.description: The raw postal code that the syndromic surveillance event contributes to in the syndrome trend.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_ONSET_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the syndromic surveillance event is considered hospital onset. 'Y' indicates that the event is considered hospital onset. 'N' or NULL indicate that the event is not considered hospital onset.

columns.name: RECORD_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: The date the record was created.
